it actually happened over the course of many nights, but this is truly the foundational text for romantic comedies.

the scene of ellie as a runaway bride was gorgeous and her dad was so real for giving her an escape option in a wedding that never needed to happen. 

we were definitely robbed of seeing ellie and peter reuniting and sharing an actual kiss as a couple in love, but knowing clark gable had halitosis actually makes the ending so valid!

Name: The Drama
Review:
thankfully i was in a theater that saw this as the dark comedy that it is and we were laughing loud. zendaya you’ll never do any wrong in my eyes so i’m glad that her character (emma) wasn’t the actual villain in this movie. 

i’m sorry but we can’t live in WHAT IFS, every other character actually did the action that was their claimed “worst thing” except for emma. 

by the end of it, emma’s empathy really showed through and charlie will have to spend the rest of his life making up for doing the actual worst thing thing that he’s ever done. 

EYE felt the chemistry between zendaya and robert pattinson, these reviews are confusing me!

Name: All the President's Men
Review:
i LOVE a good journalist procedural movie and i wouldn’t be surprised to learn if this one was the big momma. 

i looked up what the actual bob woodward looked like and he’s sooo real for having robert redford portray him in this movie, God bless him!

i’ve always thought this, but i still can’t believe the biggest scandal in the nation at the time relied on an informant called “deep throat”… like that’s just so silly.

so this is just a ridiculously shot movie, every single frame is beautiful. 

shoutout to arthur for being the most understanding husband of all time, because the scene of nora and hae sung having that sweet conversation in front of him was crazy (complimentary). 

i remember when this movie first came out, a lot of people were talking about how romantic the scene of nora and arthur in bed together was. but i raise you hae sung saying “see you then” to nora before getting in taxi and driving out of her life permanently. that’s a yearner!
